description: The Wood Tiger in Chinese astrology: personality, Wood element traits, 1974 and 2034 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Wood Tiger is the Tiger born in a Wood year, one of five versions of the third animal. It combines the Tiger's courage with Wood's qualities. Wood Tiger years between 1924 and 2044 are 1974 and 2034. The Tiger's fixed element is Wood.

sections.heading: The Wood Tiger personality
paragraphs: In the Wood Tiger, the year stem matches the animal's own element, because the Tiger always carries Wood. Traditional readings describe this as the Tiger's courage blended with an unusually generous, sociable temperament. Wood Tigers are often pictured as friendly, imaginative and cooperative, willing to share the spotlight and gather allies around a cause. They keep the sign's bold independence but tend to use it in service of growth and fairness rather than pure conquest. Doubled Wood brings vision and enthusiasm in abundance. It can also scatter their energy across too many ventures, and their idealism may make them impatient with slower, more cautious people who do not share their sense of possibility.

Wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak. Classical descriptions link it with kindness, idealism and a talent for cooperation: Wood people are often pictured as the ones who start community projects, mentor younger colleagues and believe that most situations can improve with patience and goodwill. The element also carries a strong sense of fairness and a dislike of waste. Its shadow side, according to most readings, is overextension. Like a plant reaching in every direction, a Wood-year person may take on too much, trust too readily or struggle to say no when a cause seems worthwhile.

sections.heading: Wood Tiger at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, the Wood element is usually linked with planning, teaching and collaborative building. Wood-year people are often described as good at seeing how a team could grow and at nurturing the people inside it, which suits roles in education, design, community work, healthcare and any field with a long horizon. They tend to prefer cooperation over rivalry. The traditional warning is about scope: a Wood stem can start more ventures than it can finish, so firm priorities and honest deadlines usually serve it well.

The Wood Tiger leads by inviting people in, which makes it a natural founder of clubs, campaigns and creative studios. Readings tie it to advocacy, festival production, outdoor education, publishing and early-stage ventures, anywhere bold ideas need allies to succeed. Its enthusiasm can outrun the budget, so a grounded co-lead who handles schedules and invoices is a real asset. In romance the Wood Tiger is open-hearted and fun, eager to share expeditions and late-night conversations about how the world could be better. It wants freedom within commitment and someone happy to share it with a wide circle of friends. Where it rubs is scattered attention: so many invitations accepted that the closest relationship occasionally gets the leftovers.

sections.heading: Wood Tiger years and dates
paragraphs: The table from 1924 to 2044 holds 2 Wood Tiger years: 1974, starting Jan 23 and 2034, starting Feb 19. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 2034 anyone born before Feb 19 is a Water Ox, not a Wood Tiger. It takes sixty years for the Wood stem and the Tiger branch to coincide again, which is why the same pairing marks grandparents and grandchildren rather than siblings. Every Wood Tiger year is Yang, matching the Tiger's own polarity.

In the sexagenary calendar this is the Jia-Yin year, the Wood stem Jia with the Tiger's branch Yin. Births just before each new year fall in the Water Ox year (before January 23, 1974) and the Water Ox year (before February 19, 2034), and births in the weeks after each Wood Tiger year ends belong to the Wood Rabbit. The new year itself fell on a Wednesday in 1974 and Sunday in 2034.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Wood Tiger
paragraphs: Growth for the Wood Tiger usually means learning to prune. Readings suggest that this combination thrives when it chooses a few causes worth its courage and lets the rest go. Wood Tigers may also struggle with follow-through once the exciting early phase of a project is over, so partnering with patient finishers helps. Because they trust readily, checking commitments before relying on them is wise. Physical activity outdoors tends to settle their abundant energy. When the Wood Tiger focuses its generosity rather than spreading it thin, it becomes an inspiring leader who lifts others as it moves forward.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Wood Tiger shares the Tiger's San He trine with the Horse and Dog (the Fire trine), its Liu He bond with the Pig, and its Liu Chong clash with the Monkey. The element adds a second layer: another Wood sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Wood in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Wood Tiger years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1974 (from January 23, 1974) and 2034 (from February 19, 2034). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Wood Tiger's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Wood and the Tiger's fixed element is Wood; in the five-element cycles wood year element matches the fixed element. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Wood Tiger?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Horse and Dog (San He) and the Pig (Liu He). The Monkey is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Wood Tiger called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Jia-Yin. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Wood stem Jia, followed by its earthly branch, here Yin for the Tiger, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Wood Tiger different from other Tigers?
faq.answer: All Tigers share courage, independence and magnetic energy. The Wood year element changes the tone: wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak.
